prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic architectural fashion portrait of an approved adult woman crouched on a concrete corner.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult blonde woman with natural full hair, defined brows, large silver hoops, and a beaded bracelet. She wears a white leather strapless corset-style top, white mini skirt, and white knee-high boots, crouching with one hand on her knee and looking directly at camera.

prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Natural diffused daylight, soft shadows, sharp leather, hair, wood, brick, and concrete texture, bold clean editorial mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 4K-style vertical photography, sharp subject, realistic proportions, natural color and depth.
